results.title: July sees record number of AI agents going out of control

results.title: 49-Years-Owned 1955 Volkswagen Beetle
results.description: This 1955 Volkswagen Beetle was purchased by the seller's spouse in 1977 from a co-worker, said to be the original owner, and was then kept off the road for many years and all winters. Finished in black over red vinyl upholstery, the car is powered by a replacement 1,192cc flat-four paired with a four-speed manual transaxle. Equipment includes 15" steel wheels with hubcaps in addition to chrome bumpers, dual side mirrors, a cabin heater, and front bucket seats. Showing 43k miles, this Type 1 Beetle is offered by the seller on behalf of their spouse's estate with a spare engine and parts as well as a clean Massachusetts title in the owner's name.
